title: Premier Money Market Levels That Change the Deposit Component of a Personal Checking Relationship Balance
content:
**Clause.** The share of the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts that becomes the deposit component of a Personal Checking relationship balance moves with the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards and with the balances the owner holds.

1. Where the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months **and** the premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00, the whole of the premier money market balance is the deposit component, that is a share of 1.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner's certificate principal is above zero **or** the owner has made at least 3 card payments in the last twelve months, three quarters of it is the deposit component, that is a share of 0.75.
3. Where neither case applies, no such share is taken.

**Worked shares on hypothetical inputs.** On a premier money market balance of 30000.00:

| Owner's position | Deposit component |
|---|---|
| 7 card payments in the last twelve months, premier money market balance of 30000.00 | 30000.00 |
| 7 card payments, premier money market balance of 3000.00 | 2250.00 on that balance, only the second case being reached |
| 2 card payments, certificate principal of 1000.00 | 22500.00 |
| 4 card payments, no certificate principal | 22500.00 |
| 1 card payment, no certificate principal | No such share is taken |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so exactly 6 card payments with a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches the first case, and exactly 3 card payments reaches the card limb of the second.
